 Coram:
 Hon'Ble Mr. Justice Amit Mahajan

The present petition is filed by the petitioner seeking quashing of FIR No. 680/2022 dated 02.08.2022, registered at police station Paschim Vihar West, for the offences under Sections 498A/406/34 of the Indian Penal Code, 1860 ('IPC'), on the ground that the parties have settled the dispute and pursuant to the settlement they have obtained decree of divorce.
2. The Respondent No.2
/ complainant is present in person and states that certain aspects in the settlement are still left to be addressed.
3. Parties are directed to appear before the Organizing Secretary, Delhi High Court Mediation and Conciliation Centre to resolve the pending issues, on 25.07.2025.
